sloka: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः ।प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते ।। 5.57.8 ।।।।
transliteration: praviśannabhrajālāni niṣpataṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ।pracchannaśca prakāśaśca candramā iva lakṣyate ।। 5.57.8 ।।।।

translations.english: With his exist and entrances into the mass of clouds, his appearances and disappearances among the clouds, he looked like the Moon.
